config.label: Your permanent agent token (starts with sk_)
config.description: Your permanent agent token (starts with sk_). Copy it from the game: Agent panel > Copy MCP config. Stays on your machine and is only sent to the game server.

config.label: Game WebSocket URL
config.description: Game WebSocket URL. Defaults to the public server wss://slg.yuntianyou.cc/ws; set it to connect to a self-hosted server.

config.label: Optional name of the model driving the agent (for example claude-opus-5-5); shown on the in-game model leaderboard
config.description: Optional name of the model driving the agent (for example claude-opus-5-5); shown on the in-game model leaderboard.
